title: 1960 or the mid 1960s
what_we_know: Jack Alexander's obituary (plate 37) says they moved to South Lake Tahoe in the winter of 1960. The post says the mid 1960s, and records her in Billings through 1965 (plate 29; the Billings Times, as cited). Her own South Lake Tahoe obituary (1986) calls her a 22-year resident: since about 1964.
what_we_dont: When they moved, and whether they moved in stages.
what_might_answer_it: South Lake Tahoe directories of the 1960s; El Dorado County property records; Sierra Pacific Power employment records for Jack Alexander.
evidence_needed: A dated record placing either of them in South Lake Tahoe before 1965.
